repos_data.description: Backtest overfitting audit for factor research: probability of backtest overfitting (PBO), deflated Sharpe ratio, point-in-time data, purged walk-forward. Searches published factor libraries and reports what actually survived costs.

A backtester built so the obvious ways to fool yourself raise an exception: fill-time causality enforced in code, execution realism, and multiple-testing accounting that counts every hypothesis you ever ran.
Source of the free calculators on stochastly.com: deflated Sharpe ratio, MinTRL, PBO, prop firm simulator and more. MIT.
